text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Yukino Bijin's determination as
inspiration, I find myself typing
out a list
of specialized training regimen ideas.
P-pard'n the intrusion!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good! I've got the right room! Sorry
t'barge in when you're work'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, I wanna thank you for help'n me out
yesterday, so um... Here you
go! I hope
you like't.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hands over a paper bag. Peeking
inside reveals a fancy box of
rice crackers
with the words "Made in Morioka" written
across the top.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You look like a busy bee right now, but be
sure to give 'em a taste
late—hm? What
are these notes? Why's my name written
on 'em?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What?! Ch-cheese and crackers! Is this a
train'n plan for me?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Like to? I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wowzers... I had no idea train'n like this
existed! And these notes are
so easy
t'understand.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainers here'n the capital really are on
the cutt'n edge! My club back
home never
did anyth'n like this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Righty-roo! I was born in a teeny tiny
village up north. The scenery
there is
amaz'n, and the people are so kind!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, I don't wanna bore you. It's not
exactly the most interest'n
place. But...
Ehehe, if you insist.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The weather in my village is freez'n cold,
and we get heaps of snow
ev'ry year. In
winter, it's like the world's been covered in
a fluffy white
blanket.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? Snow muffles all the
sounds 'round it. That's why it's so
quiet in
winter...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All you can hear is your own footsteps. It's
like you're all alone in a
endless sea of
white... Runn'n through the snow makes
you feel like
you could go on forever...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's how I fell in love with runn'n. I
joined a club after that, and
everyone was
always tell'n me how fast I was...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
They cheered me on when I was li'l, so
when they started talking
about me mak'n
it big in Tokyo, even I started t'believe I
could do it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll admit though, I had a bad case of the butterflies. I wasn't even sure why I wanted t'go to the city... But that's when my friend Mifuyu set me straight!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She helped me realize what I really
want—t'be a city girl as bright 'n'
bold as
the sun!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She is! That's why I wanna get better! Next
time she sees me, I'm
gonna be the
spiffiest runner she ever laid eyes on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Speak'n of runn'n... What do you... think of
my current skills?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes glimmer with anticipation. She's
heard nothing but empty
praise from
people who only see her as the latest
trend, but all she
wants is... the truth.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe! I knew it... Thanks for being frank
with me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'm a little sick of ev'ryone
tiptoe'n around me. I wanna
be a real city
girl, and no pop'larity contest is gonna get
me there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging from how she uses that term, it's
clear it means more to her
than just being
a trendy city slicker.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You... you really wanna know?!
Well... a city girl is... just the
coolest cat
there is!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sure, they may look pretty, but they're so much more'n glitz and glam! City girls gotta have the conf'dence and, um... power? And, and...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You know what? It'd be faster t'show you!
C'mon, I'll intr'duce you to
the spiffiest
city girl there is! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, Nakayama Racecourse comes
into view. Yukino Bijin's
gaze focuses on a
certain Umamusume, who turns towards
her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, it's Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Zounds! How'd she know’t was me?! Does
she have super vision?!
That's so cooool!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yup! That's City! Even among the other
city girls, she's the cream of
the crop!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I saw her in a magazine before
com'n to Tokyo. I didn't
recognize her at
first, so we were both pretty gobsmacked
when I was
tell'n her 'bout it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race begins, and Gold City zooms
down the track. Her running
form certainly
is beautiful, but there's an undeniable
ferocity behind
it as well.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't she just the bee's knees? The
whole crowd went wild!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Right? A true city girl's got beauty, brains,
and brawn, all wrapped
up'n one package!
That's what I wanna be...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe then I could b'come Morioka's
star... Not just a pass'n fad, but
a real,
honest-to-goodness legend!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oguri and Inari both became stars 'cause
of their skills, and City's the
same! I wanna
be just like them...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But... right now, all a bumpkin like me is
good for is some
lame-brained trend... I
just wanna show 'em I'm more'n just a
pretty
face.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-you really think I've got what it takes? I
dunno...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin goes quiet as she continues to
walk along. After a few
moments, she
breaks her silence.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You know someth'n? You're a lot like the
people'n my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I feel like you're look'n at the real me, just like the folks back home. And... I can tell you're cheer'n for me with all your heart.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Will this train'n regimen get me closer
t'being a city girl?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Th-then, um... The tryouts are fast
approach'n, and I was think'n... If I
can
show people what I can do there, maybe
they'll fin'lly see the real
me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So um... If it's all right with you... Could
you supervise my train'n till
then?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-you don't need to take me on full-time,
of course! Just till the
tryouts! P-pretty
please!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Truly?! Thanks oodles! I'm look'n forward
t'whatever you've got in
store for me!
